takeaway: IMN has today quieter with only isolated peninsula showers, then a possible humidity/rain bump into Guanacaste this weekend. No tropical cyclone near Costa Rica; EPAC interest stays well offshore southwest of Mexico and trending west.

periods.label: Days 1–3 (Wed–Fri)
periods.pattern: Isolated–scattered Pacific-side showers/storms; morning clearer stretches; midweek Papagayo still fresh (marine).
periods.implications: Outdoor mornings look more usable than late afternoons; heat still high (IMN Nicoya max ~35°C).
periods.confidence: High for no nearby TC and isolated rain theme (IMN + models agree). Moderate on exact shower timing.

periods.label: Days 4–7 (Sat–Tue)
periods.pattern: Weekend moisture/instability uptick possible as trades ease and tropical-wave influence returns (IMN weekly). Models split on how strongly SW/onshore low-level flow develops over Nicoya.
periods.implications: Plan flexibly for wetter afternoons into the weekend; not locked as a multi-day temporal.
periods.confidence: Moderate for wetter than midweek; low–moderate for a sustained temporales pattern.

periods.label: Days 8–15
periods.pattern: Broadly quieter Pacífico Norte rainfall risk vs normal (IMN sub-seasonal deficit; CPC text leans drier Caribbean weeks 2–3). Far-west EPAC genesis scenarios stay distant from Nicoya.
periods.implications: No clear flood-season spike in the official longer-range guidance; short heavy cells can still happen.
periods.confidence: Moderate for below-normal / no major-system theme; low for day-by-day rain.

gyreWatch.possibleTiming: Late weekend into ~Tue 22–23 Sep, only if SW Pacific-side flow and flanking lows persist
gyreWatch.supporting: IMN weekend wave/humidity language; GFS 06Z 16 Sep and GEFS mean show weaker Caribbean/Pacific lows and more SW 850 hPa flow later.
gyreWatch.conflicting: NHC has no disturbance near CR; EC-AIFS 06Z keeps easterlies Sat 19; AIFS-ENS early frames lack a closed Central American gyre; IMN sub-seasonal still favors Pacific deficit. Ensemble means only — no member-count probabilities.

whatChanged: This is the first briefing, so no day-to-day model drift comparison yet.
practical: Best apparent outdoor windows: mornings Wed–Fri while IMN keeps rains more isolated on the peninsula. Worth planning around: possible weekend wetter stretch in Guanacaste, and Papagayo NE–E 20–25 kt with seas ~6–10 ft early week easing later (NHC OFFPZ8 PMZ113). No new IMN aviso dated 16 Sep at collection time.
